- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Shows yellowing leaves with small dark spots, field-scale yellowing; test image has a discrete large dark lesion, not the same pattern
- **Anthracnose**: Primarily stem/pod disease; reference shows mature pod/stem symptoms — not matching

The **yellow halo** around a large, irregular, dark necrotic lesion on the upper leaf surface is the hallmark of **Bacterial_Blight** at an advanced stage where individual lesions have coalesced.
